dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Wow, every plant and tree here is like an old friend. I couldn't feel more at home!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: On childhood adventures, I never strayed too far. I would imagine Thornback Geckos were colossal dragons and play with them while wondering why their spines glowed.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Thinking back on it now, perhaps my curiosity with all things great and small began back then.
